CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTSt:
Captured POKéMON are registered with an ID No. and the OT.
OT stands for “Original TRAINER” - the TRAINER that caught it first.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Budd:
All right!
My buddy's going to trade me his KANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Haun:
Come on, HAUNTER!
I love HAUNTER! I collect them!
Huh?
HAUNTER turned into a different POKéMON while being traded!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanI: You can identify POKéMON you get in trades by their ID Numbers.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRP: An RPG! There's no time for that!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Spor: A sports game! Dad'll like that!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RedG: Red and Green! Both are POKéMON!
Text_CounterTeach:
Oh, hi! I finally finished POKéMON.
Not done yet? How about I teach you a good move?
The move I have in mind is COUNTER.
Not like the one I'm leaning on, mind you!
Text_CounterDeclined: You're not interested? Come see me if you change your mind.
Text_CounterWhichMon: Which POKéMON should I teach COUNTER to?
Text_CounterTaught: Are you using that COUNTER move I taught your POKéMON?
